# Historical NVDLA model before the SDP readback correction

The previous native model passed all 22 numerical jobs on seed 1 in **1512.925 seconds**. Its two exact controls rejected the deliberately corrupted answer and skipped engine enable in **57.210** and **345.392 seconds**, respectively. Those actual outcomes are retained; they are not counted as runs of the corrected native model.

A subsequent flattened synthesis check exposed 176 undriven bits on six `NV_NVDLA_SDP_reg` inputs for the absent small SDP LUT. [Patch 0003](correction.patch) gives the five 32-bit counter inputs and one 16-bit data input explicit zero drivers. The CDP LUT and large variant are unaffected. Final firmware also verifies the small capability word, zero readback after a nonzero absent-LUT write, and all six zero readbacks after each SDP job. The scalar numerical expectations and 22 job markers remain unchanged.

[Metadata](summary.json) records the exact old native/RTL/source/ELF identities, corrected RTL/patch/final-source identities, and independently checked old job/control markers. `old-tests/` preserves all original compiled test inputs byte-for-byte; the old README is named `.md.txt` to retain its original links as text. `old-build/` contains the compiler commands, logs and input provenance, and `old-campaigns/` contains complete actual commands, logs, manifests and results. [Old generation metadata](old-generation.json) includes the full original emitted-file hash inventory.

The complete original IP3 package, native binary and original ELFs remain in the local directories identified by metadata. This compact report publishes their identities and reproducible source/command evidence, without promising binary files. [Export hashes](export-hashes.json) distinguish original and portable bytes. The earlier scalar-loop timeout is documented separately in [firmware history](../firmware-history/README.md); corrected full-SoC acceptance uses fresh campaigns only.
